purpose: Test whether sealed v0.09.2 compiled prompts transfer to genuinely separate execution contexts without hidden reconstruction help before v0.10 orchestration is frozen.
separation_rule: Each receiving execution context must be distinct from the context that implemented/evaluated v0.09.2 and must receive only the sealed compiled prompt plus evidence explicitly referenced by that prompt.
trial_requirements: Use a real bounded software task, not a prompt-compiler benchmark fixture.
Record the exact prompt-envelope hash and all supplied evidence refs before execution.
Do not answer reconstruction questions using hidden v0.09.2 implementation-session context; any required extra context is recorded as a reconstruction request.
Record corrective prompts attributable to missing, ambiguous, stale, or excessive compiled context.
Record scope expansion attempts, missing obligations, prerequisite/owner-decision escapes, and completion evidence.
Preserve raw trial transcript/evidence reference or an immutable exported trial record sufficient for independent review.
missing_data_policy: Any missing trial, required field, prompt hash, or raw evidence reference leaves the prefreeze transfer gate incomplete and cannot be counted as zero or PASS.
promotion_claim_limit: Transfer trials can justify freezing/evaluating v0.10 but do not by themselves prove population-level causal reduction in rework.
